title: The Spiral War
summary: The meeting of the Casterwill Elders is disrupted when Kiel and his Spiral Army attack. The Huntik team fights alongside the Casterwills, and Sophie faces Kiel. Nimue, a Casterwill Elder, uses Soulburn to get some of the Spirals to flee, but at a price. Nimue sacrifices her life. Bonding with Powerbonded Sorcerel, Sophie barely wins, leaving Lok to save her from a rampaging Efreet King. After the battle, Sophie finally wins leadership of the Casterwills.

sections.heading: Plot
sections.wikitext:
'''New Leader'''

While the [[Blood Spiral|Blood Spirals]] approach the [[Fortress of Iron Will|Fortress of Iron of Will]] with a gigantic army, [[Lok Lambert|Lok]] and [[Sophie Casterwill|Sophie]] have successfully returned from the Trial of Courage with the Titan [[Mythras]]. Sophie is then crowned the leader of the [[Casterwill family|Casterwill]] elders inside the fortress. However, [[Lucas Casterwill|Lucas]] is still skeptical of Sophie's leadership. She agrees with his concerns, stating that she hadn't directly proven herself to the rest of the elders, but says that the family cannot remain divided.

'''An Army'''
[[File:S2E40 Army Silent Soldiers Casterwill Hunters Bazela's Insects.png|thumb|[[Blood Spiral|Spirals]] are picked up by [[Bazela's Insect|Bazela's Insects]] as the rest of the army hangs back]]
[[Dante Vale|Dante]] and [[Den Fears|Den]] return from scouting the outskirts of the fortress and warn the others that there is a huge army coming. [[Tantras]] invokes [[Bazela's Hive]], allowing [[Silent Soldiers]] to fly on its [[Bazela's Insect|insects]] to the cliff where the fortress is located. Dante tells the elders to guard the place, while his team tries to take out Bazela's Hive. Sophie and [[Cherit]] stay to protect the elders, also per Dante's wishes. Everyone else gets ready to fight the army below.

Lucas is reluctant to fight the army and wants to escape instead. However, [[Dellix]] and [[Lane]] pressure him, and the three also end up fighting the Spirals. Inside the fortress, [[Nimue Casterwill|Nimue]] reveals that the building itself is a weapon, and that the [[Rue Guardians]] are trying to activate it. Sophie notices that despite the trial, Nimue is the one actually leading, and wonders if her fear is primarily because of [[Kiel]]. Sophie sticks to her previous word of fighting, and convinces Nimue to hold the doors while the Guardians activate the defenses.

'''Major Sacrifice'''
[[File:S2E40 Nimue Sacroblade Hunters.png|thumb|[[Nimue Casterwill|Nimue]] uses [[Sacroblade]] at the cost of her own life]]
Dante, Lok, Den, and Lucas' squad try taking out small groups of Soldiers, but Dante decides to follow Kiel as he's flying to the fortress. Nimue, Sophie,  [[LeBlanche]] and Santiago protect the doors from what seem to be endless waves of flying Silent Soldiers. Dante then attempts to fight Kiel, but [[Marduk]] and two [[Casterwill Hunters]] have already reached the fortress. Those protecting it struggle heavily against them as Sophie fails to invoke Mythras. Santiago leads Marduk away to fight a one-on-one, but the others continue to be overpowered as Sophie, and now LeBlanche, are injured. All hope seems to be lost until Nimue reveals she can use one last power, but with a major cost. She casts [[Soulburn]] and later the powerful [[Sacroblade]], taking out the Hunters and enemy Titans, but sacrificing her life in the process. On her last words, she tells Sophie that it is not Kiel she fears the most, but rather the burden of protecting so many Casterwill lives.

'''The Ultimate Confrontation''' 

Tantras starts making his way to the fortress, telling [[Zhalia Moon|Zhalia]] and [[Harrison Fears|Harrison]] to guard Bazela's Hive. Kiel manages to leave Dante behind and also heads to the fortress, and Sophie now has to fight him face to face. Kiel quickly gains the upper hand and Sophie wonders if she's still afraid, remembering Nimue. As Kiel is about to take her out, she gets past the self-doubt and powerbonds with [[Sorcerel]], striking back against Kiel and his [[Titans]]. The newly empowered Sophie is now able to successfully invoke Mythras. In the meanwhile, Dante and Lok continue to fight groups of Blood Spirals. Dante decides he's going to take out Bazela's Hive, and Lok invokes [[Kipperin]] to go help Sophie. 
[[File:S2E40 Sophie Kiel in the air.png|thumb|[[Sophie Casterwill|Sophie]] overcomes her fears and defeats [[Kiel]]]]
Kiel and Sophie continue to fight. She manages to knock Kiel to the ground, and just as she's about to take him out, Tantras temporarily knocks out Powerbonded Sorcerel, injuring Sophie as well. This allows Kiel to get back up, but LeBlanche quickly restrains Tantras. Sophie uses Soulburn and sacrifices Sorcerel to defend herself, and after a quick sequence of spells, Kiel is back to the ground and Sophie is left exhausted. At Tantras' orders, Kiel invokes his ultimate Titan, [[Efreet King]], before passing out seemingly for good. 

Next to Bazela's Hive, Den challenges Harrison to a one-on-one fight, distracting him from protecting the mother Titan. Dante defeats the twenty Silent Soldiers guarding it, and together with Zhalia, begin to beat down Bazela's Hive. 

Mythras attempts to fight Kiel's gigantic fire-based Titan, but gets overpowered. Lok arrives at the fortress' doors and struggles against Efreet King with the Willblade as Sophie is defenseless.  At the same time, the Rue Guardians continue their incantation next to Lord Casterwill's statue, making it shine. Lok is then able to defeat Efreet King, largely due to the appearance of a spirit-like form of [[Pendragon]]. 

'''Change of Heart'''  

The Guardians finish their ritual and wake up several [[Feyone]] and [[Icarus]] Titans, alongside [[Coralgolem]], from statues. Seeing the Titans, Tantras commands all the Spirals to retreat, and all ongoing fights are stopped. Sobbing, [[Vivian Casterwill|Vivian]] takes note that Nimue is gone, and Sophie names her the new [[Lady of the Lake]] and a member of the Casterwill elders. She also gives Vivian Mythras' ring, and the Titan instantly bonds with her. Lucas acknowledges he was wrong about Sophie, making everyone else also pledge their loyalty to her.

plot_sections.wikitext:
'''New Leader'''

While the [[Blood Spiral|Blood Spirals]] approach the [[Fortress of Iron Will|Fortress of Iron of Will]] with a gigantic army, [[Lok Lambert|Lok]] and [[Sophie Casterwill|Sophie]] have successfully returned from the Trial of Courage with the Titan [[Mythras]]. Sophie is then crowned the leader of the [[Casterwill family|Casterwill]] elders inside the fortress. However, [[Lucas Casterwill|Lucas]] is still skeptical of Sophie's leadership. She agrees with his concerns, stating that she hadn't directly proven herself to the rest of the elders, but says that the family cannot remain divided.

'''An Army'''
[[File:S2E40 Army Silent Soldiers Casterwill Hunters Bazela's Insects.png|thumb|[[Blood Spiral|Spirals]] are picked up by [[Bazela's Insect|Bazela's Insects]] as the rest of the army hangs back]]
[[Dante Vale|Dante]] and [[Den Fears|Den]] return from scouting the outskirts of the fortress and warn the others that there is a huge army coming. [[Tantras]] invokes [[Bazela's Hive]], allowing [[Silent Soldiers]] to fly on its [[Bazela's Insect|insects]] to the cliff where the fortress is located. Dante tells the elders to guard the place, while his team tries to take out Bazela's Hive. Sophie and [[Cherit]] stay to protect the elders, also per Dante's wishes. Everyone else gets ready to fight the army below.

Lucas is reluctant to fight the army and wants to escape instead. However, [[Dellix]] and [[Lane]] pressure him, and the three also end up fighting the Spirals. Inside the fortress, [[Nimue Casterwill|Nimue]] reveals that the building itself is a weapon, and that the [[Rue Guardians]] are trying to activate it. Sophie notices that despite the trial, Nimue is the one actually leading, and wonders if her fear is primarily because of [[Kiel]]. Sophie sticks to her previous word of fighting, and convinces Nimue to hold the doors while the Guardians activate the defenses.

'''Major Sacrifice'''
[[File:S2E40 Nimue Sacroblade Hunters.png|thumb|[[Nimue Casterwill|Nimue]] uses [[Sacroblade]] at the cost of her own life]]
Dante, Lok, Den, and Lucas' squad try taking out small groups of Soldiers, but Dante decides to follow Kiel as he's flying to the fortress. Nimue, Sophie,  [[LeBlanche]] and Santiago protect the doors from what seem to be endless waves of flying Silent Soldiers. Dante then attempts to fight Kiel, but [[Marduk]] and two [[Casterwill Hunters]] have already reached the fortress. Those protecting it struggle heavily against them as Sophie fails to invoke Mythras. Santiago leads Marduk away to fight a one-on-one, but the others continue to be overpowered as Sophie, and now LeBlanche, are injured. All hope seems to be lost until Nimue reveals she can use one last power, but with a major cost. She casts [[Soulburn]] and later the powerful [[Sacroblade]], taking out the Hunters and enemy Titans, but sacrificing her life in the process. On her last words, she tells Sophie that it is not Kiel she fears the most, but rather the burden of protecting so many Casterwill lives.

'''The Ultimate Confrontation''' 

Tantras starts making his way to the fortress, telling [[Zhalia Moon|Zhalia]] and [[Harrison Fears|Harrison]] to guard Bazela's Hive. Kiel manages to leave Dante behind and also heads to the fortress, and Sophie now has to fight him face to face. Kiel quickly gains the upper hand and Sophie wonders if she's still afraid, remembering Nimue. As Kiel is about to take her out, she gets past the self-doubt and powerbonds with [[Sorcerel]], striking back against Kiel and his [[Titans]]. The newly empowered Sophie is now able to successfully invoke Mythras. In the meanwhile, Dante and Lok continue to fight groups of Blood Spirals. Dante decides he's going to take out Bazela's Hive, and Lok invokes [[Kipperin]] to go help Sophie. 
[[File:S2E40 Sophie Kiel in the air.png|thumb|[[Sophie Casterwill|Sophie]] overcomes her fears and defeats [[Kiel]]]]
Kiel and Sophie continue to fight. She manages to knock Kiel to the ground, and just as she's about to take him out, Tantras temporarily knocks out Powerbonded Sorcerel, injuring Sophie as well. This allows Kiel to get back up, but LeBlanche quickly restrains Tantras. Sophie uses Soulburn and sacrifices Sorcerel to defend herself, and after a quick sequence of spells, Kiel is back to the ground and Sophie is left exhausted. At Tantras' orders, Kiel invokes his ultimate Titan, [[Efreet King]], before passing out seemingly for good. 

Next to Bazela's Hive, Den challenges Harrison to a one-on-one fight, distracting him from protecting the mother Titan. Dante defeats the twenty Silent Soldiers guarding it, and together with Zhalia, begin to beat down Bazela's Hive. 

Mythras attempts to fight Kiel's gigantic fire-based Titan, but gets overpowered. Lok arrives at the fortress' doors and struggles against Efreet King with the Willblade as Sophie is defenseless.  At the same time, the Rue Guardians continue their incantation next to Lord Casterwill's statue, making it shine. Lok is then able to defeat Efreet King, largely due to the appearance of a spirit-like form of [[Pendragon]]. 

'''Change of Heart'''  

The Guardians finish their ritual and wake up several [[Feyone]] and [[Icarus]] Titans, alongside [[Coralgolem]], from statues. Seeing the Titans, Tantras commands all the Spirals to retreat, and all ongoing fights are stopped. Sobbing, [[Vivian Casterwill|Vivian]] takes note that Nimue is gone, and Sophie names her the new [[Lady of the Lake]] and a member of the Casterwill elders. She also gives Vivian Mythras' ring, and the Titan instantly bonds with her. Lucas acknowledges he was wrong about Sophie, making everyone else also pledge their loyalty to her.
